items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Fantom on trombone, Judge George Dunlap on trombone, yeah.

ctx.x: Yes, because we had five brass, we had three trumpets -- five brass, six, with Louis, because when Louis come in, it would be four trumpets. Myself on the trumpet, and there was Milton Fletcher and this other fellow, I forget his name, yeah. Eddie Fantom on trombone, Judge George Dunlap on trombone, yeah.
Well, I guess the record business was pretty bad at that time, and that's why there was no recording contract.
